notes: The owner, 2026-08-07: *"rather than being able to display on one active right hand side panel … I would prefer for the right hand side to be a MDI multi floating panel workspace where any number of tabs can be open as floating panels … When 'reduced' the tab is retained and the panel is invisible."* Read literally that is a windowing change.
